subject: Private patch orchestration — dry run / playcall (June 12)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@zenithretail.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Private patch orchestration — dry run / playcall (June 12)

Team —

We have the ZenithRetail private deployment dry run scheduled for Friday, June 12 (US-PST). This thread is to lock the playcall checklist and call out gating/rollback owners before the run. High-level goal: run the canonical patch workflow end-to-end (preflight -> pin eviction -> patch -> health validation -> unpin/restore) in a non-production canary pool and rehearse the rollback within the 60-minute window.

Proposed timeline (local PST):
- 08:00 – Preflight & NetOps quiesce checks (2 nodes)
- 08:15 – Pin eviction for canary slice
- 08:25 – Apply platform patch + DB migration smoke (if applicable)
- 08:40 – Health probes + synthetic traffic validation (10m)
- 08:55 – Execute rollback drill (if any failure)
- 09:10 – Post-run notes and action items

Open asks:
1) Karthik — confirm the BGP quiesce steps and whether we should include a temporary route-blackhole for the canary slice (we prefer graceful drain).
2) Neha — will you own the telemetry regression gating? I need the exact alert list you want us to watch and the escalation matrix.
3) Stephanie — can you confirm runbook links + who will trigger the automated rollback-scripts if needed?

Attachments: dryrun checklist (draft), network flow diagram, rollback script summary.

Tom — looping you in for alignment. If Zenith wants a different window or a longer rollback hold, tell us here.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Kimberly —

On Tue, Jun 3, 2025 at 8:42 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We have the ZenithRetail private deployment dry run scheduled for Friday, June 12 (US-PST).

Quick notes from the runtime/networking side:
- I prefer graceful drain for the canary slice rather than a route blackhole. We'll cordon the nodes, move traffic via existing routing policies, and ensure KV cache handoff completes.
- BGP quiesce: implement the 60s hold timer + withdraw only secondary prefixes (primary prefixes remain announced). I'll send a short NetOps checklist to the drive link before EOD.
- If we see increased latency >200ms p95 or error-rate spike >1.5% during the synthetic validation, escalate to the bridge and begin rollback plan A (automated unpin + reconnect previous canary).

Also: we need to run the canary on hardware matching Zenith's configuration (same NIC drivers and kernel) — confirm with Tom which node image you want us to use.

I'll own the BGP/quiesce steps on the playcall.

—Karthik
Staff Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Baker <tbaker@zenithretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private patch orchestration — dry run / playcall (June 12)

Thanks for the heads-up, Kimberly.

A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- Maintenance window: Jun 12 at 08:00 PST works for Zenith. We can extend the rollback hold to 90 minutes if Redwood prefers — our SREs will stay on the call.
- Node image: please use "zr-node-2025-05" for the canary; it's the same kernel/NIC set as production.
- Oncall: ops-oncall@zenithretail.com (cc'd in the thread) will be monitoring. If you need escalation to our security/compliance team, ping security@zenithretail.com.

We also asked our internal compliance team to have audit logging enabled for the run — please make sure CloudTrail/flow logs are retained for 30 days for this exercise.

Tom
Director, Platform Ops — ZenithRetail

Thanks everyone — quick updates and action items (finalized):

- Timeline confirmed: Jun 12, 08:00 PST. Rollback hold extended to 90 minutes per Tom.
- Node image: using zr-node-2025-05 (per Zenith). Karthik — please include the kernel/NIC validation in preflight.
- Telemetry gating (Neha): watch list = CPU p95, request p99 latency, error-rate, kv-cache miss-rate, disk I/O wait. If any gate fails, execute rollback plan A (automated unpin + traffic reroute).
- Stephanie: please pin the Drive runbook link and be ready to execute rollback-scripts-summary.txt if I approve during the call.
- Audit / logs: Tom asked for 30-day retention of flow logs — Ops will ensure retention for the dry run workspace.

I've uploaded the final checklist to the link below and attached the trimmed rollback scripts. Please confirm with a one-line ack on this thread by EOD Thu so we can send the calendar invite to Zenith and the oncall roster.
